noticias.titulo: The Staggering Costs of a Single Data Center, From Land to Chips
noticias.descripcion: Roughly $750 billion. That's how much Meta Platforms Inc., Amazon.com Inc., Microsoft Corp. and Google owner Alphabet Inc. are expected to devote to capital expenditures this year alone. That's more than the entire gross domestic product of Ireland or Belgium. More than half of what all of the companies in the S&P 500 Index spent in total last year. Enough to cut a $5,500 check for every household in the US. Ian King, Bloomberg News US Semiconductor Reporter & Lynn Doan, Bloomberg News Managing Editor for Technology, join Businessweek Daily to break down the true cost of a single data center.

noticias.titulo: What Are QBTS Stock Investors Overlooking?
noticias.descripcion: D-Wave Quantum (QBTS) reported revenue of $3.1 million for the second quarter of 2026, a figure essentially flat compared to a year earlier. This stagnation stands out given the $5.4 billion valuation investors have placed on the business, a price that appears to anticipate rapid growth. Underneath the top line, cloud subscriptions and professional services actually expanded at double-digit rates during the period. So why did D-Wave's revenue stand still.

noticias.titulo: Why Every Snap Investor Is Looking At This One Number
noticias.descripcion: Investors buying Snap (SNAP) stock may be betting on a surprising part of the business: the subscriptions it sells directly to users. The stock lost 28% over the past twelve months, contrasting with a 17.0% return for the S&P 500. So, how many of Snapchat's users actually pay for it.
